cases.scenario: Applicant #542 is approved at p_bad=0.486, but the applicant's own features sum to +0.796 log-odds toward default. Approval survives only because the model intercept is -0.853.

hallucination_trap.false_claim: Approval is justified by checking_balance = < 0 DM.
hallucination_trap.why_false: checking_balance = < 0 DM contributes +0.572 log-odds toward default, so it argues against approval.
